repos.description: Snapifit AI：开箱即用， 您的专属 AI 教练和营养师。即刻获取个性化健康管理指导。 Your personal AI trainer and nutritionist. Get instant, personalized health management guidance, right out of the box.
repos.summary_zh: Snapifit-AI是一款AI驱动的个人健康管理工具，提供快速记录饮食运动、情绪睡眠等多维度数据，结合深度健康档案与动态记忆技术，实现智能分析趋势并生成个性化健身营养建议，支持多专家角色协同会诊。
repos.summary_en: Snapifit-AI is an AI-powered personal health management tool that enables quick logging of diet, exercise, mood, and sleep data. It leverages dynamic memory and multi-expert roles to deliver intelligent trend analysis and hyper-personalized fitness/nutrition guidance through systematic data integration.

repos.description: 面向18～55岁普通人的健康健身教练Skill，提供科学训练、营养管理、进度复盘及训记数据分析，帮助用户安全、持续地实现增肌减脂目标。
工作生活的唠叨/随笔、折腾备忘, 同时分享下观看的影视、减肥动起来的记录等。Hugo theme and personal blog system with essays, microblog-style updates, browser publishing and life data.
repos.summary_zh: Koobai/blog 是一个个人博客仓库，专注于记录工作生活感悟、技术折腾笔记及日常软件推荐。内容涵盖影视观后感、减肥健身打卡等生活化主题，兼具实用性与分享性，适合追求轻量化知识沉淀与兴趣交流的开发者。
repos.summary_en: Koobai/blog is a personal blog repository focused on daily life musings, technical experimentation notes, and software recommendations. It covers topics like movie reviews, fitness tracking, and lifestyle tips, offering a blend of practical insights and casual sharing for developers seeking lightweight knowledge documentation.

repos.description: Ollama to OpenAI compatible API gateway — multi-backend load balancing, health check, auto discovery
repos.summary_zh: Ollama2API 是一个将多个 Ollama 实例聚合为统一 OpenAI 兼容 API 的网关，支持多节点负载均衡、自动健康检查与批量扫描发现。提供 Web 管理后台、API Key 鉴权、代理集成及流式响应，零依赖 JSON 存储，适用于 AI 模型集群管理与自动化运维。
repos.summary_en: Ollama2API is a gateway that aggregates multiple Ollama instances into a unified OpenAI-compatible API, featuring multi-node load balancing, automatic health checks, and batch node discovery. It includes a web admin panel, API key authentication, proxy support, and streaming responses, using zero-dependency JSON storage for easy deployment in AI model cluster management.
